result.title: Perceptual Distortion for Overfitted Video Coding: Sliced Matching in Space, Error Alignment in Time
result.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures; submitted to IEEE ISCAS
result.summary: Recent works in neural video coding have increasingly been trading off perceptual quality against reconstruction fidelity at a fixed bitrate. Wasserstein Distortion (WD) offers a principled approach to balancing these objectives by relaxing spatial correspondences in feature matching, enabling lightweight overfitted image codecs to compete with computationally intensive generative decoders. Extending vanilla WD to video, however, presents two challenges: its independent Gaussian approximation limits the expressiveness of feature distribution matching, while unconstrained texture resampling across frames introduces temporal inconsistencies. We address these challenges by distinguishing between the correspondences that can be relaxed and those that must be preserved. Spatially, we introduce a local sliced Wasserstein distortion (SWD) that matches empirical feature distributions through one-dimensional optimal transport, capturing cross-channel dependencies without enforcing exact spatial alignment. Temporally, we employ a novel flow residual that constrains coding errors along motion trajectories, preserving temporal consistency without imposing additional reconstruction fidelity constraints. Evaluated on UVG and HEVC Class B with the overfitted codec COOL-CHIC, our framework achieves BD-rate reductions of 9.2% in DISTS and 3.0% in LPIPS relative to frame-wise WD, averaged over test sequences, while lowering tOF by 10.2% at matched rate.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对过拟合神经视频编码中的感知失真建模，提出空间上的局部 sliced Wasserstein 失真以放松特征匹配的空间对应，并用沿运动轨迹约束误差的流残差保持时间一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「放松可放松的对应、保留必须保留的对应」的一维最优传输分布匹配思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 相似度量如何权衡位置对应与内容/分布一致性提供可核查的度量线索，但与推理机制本身无直接联系。
